items.titleZh: 向乔治致敬，你付出了所有，让我们无数次感到自豪
items.summaryZh: 乔治·拉塞尔表示本赛季开始得如他所愿，但很快因运气不佳和表现不佳而陷入困境。

media.altZh: 向乔治致敬，你付出了所有，让我们无数次感到自豪 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: Head up, George. You’ve given absolutely everything and made us proud countless times along the way. We win together, we lose together, and we keep f...
items.summaryEn:
Head up, George. You’ve given absolutely everything and made us proud countless times along the way.
We win together, we lose together, and we keep fighting together. 
Always 🩵George Russell: Now feels like a pretty suitable moment to speak from the heart. This season started off exactly how I had hoped but it very quickly unravelled with tough luck and poor performances. It’s been the first proper season of my career where I’ve had more bad days than good.
detailZh:
抬头，乔治。你付出了所有，无数次让我们感到自豪。
我们共同胜利，共同失败，并且我们一起战斗。
现在对乔治·拉塞尔来说：现在是一个很好的时刻，从心底说出。这个赛季开始得正是我所希望的，但很快因为不幸和糟糕的表现而变得混乱。这是我职业生涯中第一个真正的赛季，坏日子比好日子多。
detailEn:
Head up, George. You’ve given absolutely everything and made us proud countless times along the way.
We win together, we lose together, and we keep fighting together. 
Always 🩵George Russell: Now feels like a pretty suitable moment to speak from the heart. This season started off exactly how I had hoped but it very quickly unravelled with tough luck and poor performances. It’s been the first proper season of my career where I’ve had more bad days than good.
